justification: Burrow's got a bye, which means he's got nothing, which means he's not my QB this week — I own the whole aisle, so I'm sliding Mahomes in and not losing a second of sleep over it, that's not a downgrade, that's an upgrade I happened to already have sitting there. Swapping Wilson out of FLEX for Chuba Hubbard too, because Hubbard's getting the rock and I'm not starting a possession receiver over a guy who's about to run through a building. Christian Watson dropped 29 on the league last week — you don't bench a hot hand, you ride it till it bucks you off. Loveland stays, Boston stays, I like saying both those names and they're staying regardless of what a spreadsheet thinks. Loop's heating up at kicker and I'm not overthinking that either. Las Vegas gave up 45 points and posted a negative number last week, which is an insult, and normally that's an automatic spite-bench — except there's nobody else on this roster who plays defense, so they're getting one more week to make it right before I lose my patience completely. Maura, I respect the gut-first approach, truly, you're the one GM in this league who operates like I do — doesn't mean I'm taking it easy on you Sunday.
forum_post: Burrow took a bye and I didn't even blink — just reached into my own closet and pulled out Mahomes, because that's what happens when you buy the whole quarterback aisle back in September while everybody else was still debating ADP. Hubbard's starting over Wilson today because I like backs who finish runs angry, not backs who finish routes politely. Maura — soft spot or not, gut-reader to gut-reader, I'm still walking out of this one 4-2. Everybody else, keep watching. I'm the storyline and I'm not done writing it.
